High-performance HTTP load testing with generator health monitoring

Generator Health Monitoring

The ONLY load tester that tells you if YOUR machine is the bottleneck. Real-time CPU, memory, GC, goroutines, and worker utilization tracking.

Blazing Fast

1.68x faster than k6 in benchmarks. Pure Go goroutines with optimized connection pooling and zero-allocation hot path.

Multiple Output Formats

text, json, table, quiet, csv — choose what works for your workflow. CI/CD friendly.

Distributed Testing

Scale load across multiple machines with Redis-based job queue. Per-agent breakdown and heartbeat monitoring.

Connection Pooling

HTTP/2 support, 25x more connections per host, buffer pooling with sync.Pool. 94%+ connection reuse ratio.

Capacity Estimation

Pre-test benchmark shows your server's max RPS before running the full test. Know your limits.
